description: This file defines the enum `PortfolioAccountType` which categorizes different types of portfolio accounts such as invalid, loan, and savings, along with associated utility methods.

classes.name: PortfolioAccountType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of portfolio accounts with utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the account type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding PortfolioAccountType enum.

methods.name: isSavingsAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current account type is SAVINGS.

methods.name: isLoanAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current account type is LOAN.
